description:
FOUND s504 (Fable, 2026-10-02) by the OWED quiet full companion run (#2389; ~/pcl-agent-scratch/s504/companion/run.log, main b7ec0093).  SILENT WRONG + a BASELINE REGRESSION: 7,750 companion rows lost since 2026-09-26 and never seen, because the eight files are reached ONLY by the full form (`--quick` skips the #326 hang set / caps their allowance).

THE BUG (pre-existing, cross-file).  A file-level `my` that a named sub or a BEGIN block captures is PROMOTED to a package cell (Pl/Parser2.pm _promote_captured).  The cell is a SYMBOL in the declaring package: the lexical`s OWN name on the identity branch (~line 4836: "file-unique name ... promote under its OWN name"), `$name__file__N` otherwise (N = a per-FILE counter that starts at 0).  Neither spelling carries the FILE, so "file-unique" is checked against ONE compilation unit while the cell is shared by every file compiled into that package:

  (I)  identity cell vs a package GLOBAL of that name in ANOTHER file
         a.pl:  $file = "outer";  do "./v2.pl";  print "outer file=$file\n";
         v2.pl: my $file; BEGIN { $file = 5 } print "f=$file\n"; 1;
       perl: outer file=outer      PCL: outer file=5
  (II) two files of ONE package, each with a captured file lexical of the same name
         m1.pl: my $count = 10; sub a { $count } require "./m2.pl"; bump(); bump(); print "a=", a(), " b=", b(), "\n";
         m2.pl: my $count = 0; sub bump { $count++ } sub b { $count } 1;
       perl: a=10 b=2              PCL: a=2 b=2
       (the mangled path collides the same way: both files mint `$x__file__0`.)
Reproducers: ~/pcl-agent-scratch/s504/review/{w7,v2,v8,m1,m2,a2,b2}.pl.  #470 (completed) fixed the SAME-file half of (I) only: "the file must not name the PACKAGE variable" -- another file naming it is invisible to that test.

HOW IT BECAME A REGRESSION.  perl`s t/re/regexp_{normal,noamp,notrie,qr,qr_embed,trielist,nonull}.t and re/regex_sets_compat.t are wrappers:
    for $file (`./re/regexp.t`, `./t/re/regexp.t`, `:re:regexp.t`) { if (-r $file) { do $file or die $@; exit } }
and re/regexp.t opens with `my ($file, $iters); BEGIN { $iters = shift || 1; $file = shift; ... }`.  The wrapper`s GLOBAL loop variable $main::file aliases a LITERAL; regexp.t`s identity-promoted lexical IS that symbol.  Until aa657c6b the BEGIN silently overwrote the caller`s loop variable (wrong, unobserved).  aa657c6b (s497b member 4, #1391/#2103: "a literal in a promoting foreach list is a read-only box" -- CORRECT per perl) made the same write die "Modification of a read-only value attempted at (eval 1) line 1", so `do $file or die $@` aborts and the file produces NO rows.  Bisected over main`s first-parent history with the a2/b2 pair (GOOD fca715fb 1c2fe409 0fb74666; FIRST BAD aa657c6b).  re/alpha_assertions.t spells the loop `for my $file` and runs (1942/87).

  file                     snapshot (perl-suite-run.tsv)   now (b7ec0093)
  re/regexp_normal.t       DIFF 2021/8                     DIFF 0/0
  re/regex_sets_compat.t   DIFF 1755/274                    DIFF 0/0
  re/regexp_noamp.t        TIMEOUT 796/109                 DIFF 0/0
  re/regexp_notrie.t / _qr.t / _qr_embed.t / _trielist.t   TIMEOUT 795/110 each -> DIFF 0/0
  re/regexp_nonull.t       DIFF 0/0 (XS::APItest)          unchanged -- but now for THIS cause first
  = 7,752 passing rows.  s497b is NOT at fault and is not to be reverted: the read-only box is perl`s behaviour; it removed the mask.

WHY THE OBVIOUS FIXES ARE NOT ENOUGH (read before designing):
  * "always mangle" does not help: the counter is per file (two files both mint `$x__file__0`), and for a SCALAR the mangled decl emits (p-alias-eval-cell `$x $x__file__N) at its run position (M-F, ir-spec 9.1), which points the ORIGINAL-name global at the cell -- "one storage location per name, time-ordered, exactly v1`s defvar model".  So the package global of that name is clobbered on the mangled path too.  The conflation of "file lexical" with "package variable of the same name" is the string-eval lookup`s global fall-through, by design.
  * p-defcell is defvar-shaped (a module is evaluated at compile AND at load, so an unconditional fresh box would lose what BEGIN stored); a fresh box per load is not a fix either -- B`s subs name the SYMBOL, so a dynamic rebinding around the `do` would leave them reading A`s cell after the loop.
  * the symbol must therefore be FILE-PRIVATE, and string eval must reach it by the capture alist / a per-file alias table instead of the package-global fall-through.  That is var-handling-review-s379`s Direction A (bind-once symbol table) territory: a Fable DESIGN, then an Opus batch.  Name-resolution change => the full sweep IS the gate, gate-SET scan over both populations, and the FULL companion (not --quick: this bug lives in the files --quick skips).

MEASURE FIRST (cheap, before the design): (a) how many promotions per population take the identity branch vs the mangle (`PCL_CAPREFUSE`-style counter in _promote_captured); (b) how many files are compiled into a package ANOTHER compiled file also uses (do/require of a path; `package main` in a module) -- the population where (I)/(II) can fire at all; (c) how many of those have a string eval after the decl (the files that need the alias path).

A NARROW STEP THAT IS CORRECT ON ITS OWN, if (b) is small: a file reached by `do FILE` / `require "path"` (not `use Module`) mints its promoted cells with a FILE TOKEN (`$file__file__<crc>N`; every `__file__\d+$` parser keeps working) and takes NO identity branch and NO original-name alias when the package is one the PROGRAM file also compiles into; its string evals reach the cell through the capture alist (#296-B1, #2285 `_identity_eval_caps`).  That restores the eight wrappers and fixes (II) for the perl-4 `require "lib.pl"` shape; the module-vs-module half waits for the design.

BAR: the three reproducer pairs == perl; the eight files back to at least their snapshot rows on a FULL companion leg; guard rows in a new Pl/t file (two-file fixtures); sweep TOTAL + 0 LOST; gate-SET scan both populations; EVERYDAY unchanged.

BOOKKEEPING s504 (deliberate): the eight snapshot rows and their row-level baselines are NOT spliced down -- they keep the pre-regression counts, so every FULL companion run reports the 7,752 LOST rows until this task is fixed (a regression is fixed, never blessed over).  baselines/perl-suite-run.tsv carries a header note naming this task.


=== DONE (s504c) === A + B shipped (worktree agent-a41c97e5832f266e1; A 91f2d821 eval-mode units, B 93369a10 module-mode units; gen v2-3780; merges after s501t).
THE RULE: identity (p-defcell $x = the package global of that name) is a PROGRAM-unit privilege.  Parser2::_program_unit = !eval_mode && !module_unit (pl2cl passes module_unit for --module/--extension -- ONE fact).  In any other unit the promotion runs the mangle path first; identity is only the FALLBACK where the mangle path refuses.  N counts from _unit_cell_base = 1000*(1+(MD5 first 8 hex of the unit TEXT) mod 10^9) -- never a path; one text -> one emission, so the eval/module caches stay keyed by text (checked: same text at two sites / in two packages, different texts, the --eval-pkg one-shot path).  A flipped cell keeps the #2285 publication (_identity_eval_caps maps canon -> cell).  The alias (p-alias-eval-cell) STAYS: suppressed in non-program units the sweep loses t/op/eval.t 56-63 -> residue #2640.  ir-spec 2b.3 "PER UNIT" + 9.1.
STEP 0 (identity-eligible decisions under the new classifier; PCL_FILECELL_LOG):
  lib/ module mode          19 mangle / 0 fallback (4 units)
  cpan-board modules        78 mangle / 6 fallback ("dynamic string eval after decl"; 22 units)
  sweep, distinct           module 28 / 2 (test.pl %backslash_escape, %tempfiles); eval 1 / 0; program 77 identity (unchanged)
  everyday                  module 88 / 1 (Moo::_Utils %EXPORTS); program 5 identity
REPRODUCERS: a2/b2, w7/v2/v8, m1/m2, e1 == perl on the tree (all fail on b7ec0093); p1 is #2643.
BARS (93369a10): guard Pl/t/file-private-cells-01.t 18 rows (2 SBCL launches, 2.4 s; rows 1-17 FAIL on b7ec0093); corpus-diff IDENTICAL 111/111; emission-ab lib+shapes 30 SAME RCDIFF 0; module-mode A/B lib 24 + cpan 74 = pure renames (normaliser residue EMPTY); gate-SET 638x2 IDENTICAL; sweep TOTAL 18714 (+0) GATE clean drops 5; board 2278 = 2278 rows; everyday 108 -> 108 of 122.
THE EIGHT WRAPPERS (full companion on 93369a10): regexp_normal 2021/8 (= snapshot); noamp 826/79, notrie/qr/qr_embed/trielist 824/81 each (snapshot 796/109, 795/110 -- the gain is s499k #2471, spliced into baselines/perl-suite-run.tsv with cause s504c #2633); _nonull 0/0 (XS::APItest skip, unchanged); regex_sets_compat 1692/337 < snapshot 1755/274 = #2646 (not this task: byte-identical fail set at fca715fb), snapshot left.
RESIDUE TASKS: #2640 (alias in a non-program unit replaces the caller's same-named global), #2641 (container fallbacks), #2642 (the program's identity cell vs another unit's global), #2643 (do FILE sees the caller's file lexicals), #2644 (`my $x;` keeps its value on a second run of one unit), #2645 (`${x}` in a capturing named sub reads empty), #2646 (regex_sets_compat -63, bisect 97190ddc..fca715fb).


PHASE 2 (s506, s504c resumed on claude-opus-5-5): (1) Fable ruling: _unit_cell_base widened to 52 MD5 bits (1000*(1+n), n = (hex(md5[0,6]) << 28) | hex(md5[6,7]), < 2^62 integer; < 64-bit IV keeps the 30-bit arm) -- a collision is a silent shared cell, generators mint thousands of same-name eval texts (~5 % at 10k units with 30 bits, ~1e-8 with 52); guard row 19 of Pl/t/file-private-cells-01.t (property; FAILS on 0e5baf50).  (2) Rebased onto 618db500 (s501t tie merged): textual merge, artifacts regenerated (pcl-pack: three cells, 19-digit numbers).  (3) Seam with tie: six probes (scratch/s504c/seam) == perl on the tree; main shares two modules' tied %h (this task's bug).  (4) Bars on 605237f9: gate PASS 276 files / 9,576 rows; corpus-diff IDENTICAL 111, SILENT-DROP 5; emission-ab 29 SAME RCDIFF 0; module-ab lib 24 / cpan 74 RESIDUE 0; gate-SET 638x2 IDENTICAL; sweep GATE clean TOTAL 18728 (+0) drops 5; wrappers = phase 1 counts; 9 eval/do/require/tie companion files = snapshot; board 2285 = 2285; ir-conform 326/0/19/0; ir-host-leak = main 31; compile +22 % vs main (#2647, flagged); EVERYDAY 110 -> 110 of 122, buckets 0.
subject: A PROMOTED file lexical is a PACKAGE cell shared ACROSS FILES: `my $file; BEGIN { $file = shift }` in a do-file IS the caller`s $main::file, and two files of one package share `my $count` (perl a=10 b=2, PCL a=2 b=2) -- SILENT WRONG; since aa657c6b (read-only literal loop variable) it ABORTS the eight re/regexp.t wrappers: 7,752 companion rows lost, seen only by the FULL companion run
